notes.title: SOS Has Been Accepted to speedrun.com!
notes.content:
[h1]📣 Exciting News! 🎮 SOS Has Been Accepted to speedrun.com! 🌍[/h1]

We are thrilled to announce that our game has been accepted to speedrun.com, the premier global platform for speedrunning enthusiasts! 🏃‍♂️💨

Now, we invite all our dedicated players, speedrunners, and fans from around the world to showcase their skills and compete for the fastest times in our game. 🌎🌟

Whether you're a seasoned speedrunner or new to the world of speedrunning, this is your chance to show off your mastery of our game and climb up the global leader boards. ⏱️⚡

How to participate:
1️⃣ Visit speedrun.com and create an account if you haven't already.
2️⃣ Look for our game in the directory of accepted titles.
3️⃣ Start practicing and honing your speedrunning techniques.
4️⃣ Once you're ready, submit your fastest runs and join the competitive community.
[url=https://www.speedrun.com/symphony_of_souls]speedrun.com/symphony_of_souls[/url]

Join us on this thrilling journey and compete against fellow players to set new world records, discover innovative strategies, and push the boundaries of speedrunning in our game. 🌟🏆

Remember, every second counts, so put your skills to the test and let the speedrunning madness begin! ⏰🔥

Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait to see your incredible speedruns on SpeedRun.com! 🙌

- Team Eonian
